metadata.title: Hortense's Gallery
metadata.description: An interactive art gallery — drawings, paintings, ceramics.

entrance.title: Hortense's Gallery
taglines: The doors here open from the inside.
What you seek doesn't know you exist yet.
The map is not the territory. Neither is the gallery.
Enter. Your dreams made a reservation.
Here, the walls have eyes. The eyes have walls.
The labyrinth was expecting you before you were born.
Do not look for meaning. It hides remarkably well on its own.
Something in this gallery resembles you. You haven't seen it yet.
The artworks here are not hung. They stand.
You think you are visiting. The gallery is exploring you.
Every painting here has already forgotten your name.
Time moves differently near the third corridor.
The silence here has a texture.
You arrived before you decided to come.
The frames contain the walls, not the paintings.
Your shadow arrived yesterday. It has been waiting.
Nothing here is for sale. Everything here is contagious.
The artist left. The work stayed. Neither knows why.
This room was painted from memory. The memory was borrowed.
Look closer. The canvas is also looking.
The exit is where the entrance was before you moved it.
Some objects here are homesick for a world that never existed.
Your reflection in room four is two seconds ahead of you.
The gallery remembers every visitor. Especially the ones who ran.
Art here grows in the dark, between closing time and opening.
The smallest painting contains a country.
You have been in this corridor before. In a different century.
The sculpture is not unfinished. You are.
Dreams left their luggage here and never returned.
Every visitor leaves something behind without knowing it.
The walls were white once. They learned better.
Something is following you. It only moves when you look.
The clock in room two shows the correct time for a different planet.
Meaning is not lost here. It is archived.
You are the only person who has seen this gallery exactly this way.
The light here is borrowed from a star that no longer exists.
Room five is larger on the inside than the outside suggests.
The artwork is finished. The visitor is not.
Your eyes are not the only ones in this room.
The gallery does not close. It simply stops being visible.
What you cannot name has already named you.
The dust here is mostly made of forgotten intentions.
One of these paintings was completed in a dream.
This corridor leads somewhere different every third visit.
The objects here remember being something else.
Beauty arrived unannounced and has refused to leave.
The floor knows more than the ceiling will admit.
You are standing in someone else's memory.
The exhibition ends when the last question is forgotten.
Some rooms here are only visible to people who are almost asleep.
The title of this work is the feeling you had before you read it.
Each painting has a twin. The twin is invisible.
The door you did not open is the one that opened you.
Gravity here is merely a suggestion.
The colors in room three have been arguing since 1974.
You will not remember this correctly. That is the correct version.
The gallery was designed by someone who had never seen one.
Every artwork here contains one lie. Find it.
The last visitor left their curiosity behind. You are wearing it now.
entrance.map_choice_title: Would you like to take the map?
